slides.title: Turn your notes into a narrated video
bullets: Paste your source text
Pick a template and a voice
Get an MP4 with subtitles

segments.text: Hi. This is Explainer Studio, and today it is explaining itself. You give it some text, and it gives you back a narrated video.

slides.title: What is Explainer Studio?
bullets: A Windows app that turns source text into an explainer video
It writes the script, draws the slides and records the voice

segments.text: Explainer Studio is a small Windows app. You paste in source text, and it writes a script, draws the slides, records a voice and builds the video.
The writing and the voices can run entirely on your own computer.

slides.title: How it works: four steps
bullets: A local model writes a script
Slides are drawn from the script
A voice reads every slide
FFmpeg builds the video

segments.text: First, a writing model running on your machine turns the source into a script. Then the slides are drawn from that script.
Next, a voice reads every slide. Finally, FFmpeg joins the pictures and the voice into one video.

slides.title: Designed versus classic templates
bullets: Designed templates choose a layout for each slide
Classic templates keep one fixed layout

segments.text: There are two kinds of template. Designed templates look at what each slide says, and choose a layout to match, such as steps, a comparison or one big statement.
Classic templates, versus that, keep the same layout on every slide.

slides.title: Moving, in three languages
bullets: English, Arabic and Farsi, including right-to-left slides
A different transition after every slide, plus a slow zoom
Offline voices from Piper, or optional online voices

segments.text: The studio works in English, Arabic and Farsi, and right-to-left slides are drawn the right way round.
Every slide ends with a different transition, and each one drifts slowly while it is on screen. If you prefer plain cuts, you can turn that off.

slides.title: Your review comes first
bullets: Edit headings, key points and narration
Set the pause and the feeling of every spoken segment
Render the video when you are ready

segments.text: You do not have to trust the draft. The storyboard lets you edit every heading, key point and spoken sentence.
You can set the pause and the feeling of each segment, and render the video when you are ready.

slides.title: Try it yourself
bullets: Paste some text and choose a template
Review the storyboard
Download the MP4

segments.text: That is the whole idea. Paste some text, review the storyboard, and let the studio make the video.
